name: To Kill Eros
storyline:
Follow the story of Melrose Figueroa, hot-headed and foolhardy in pursuit of finding love for himself. After experiencing one of the craziest nights of his life and a near-death experience, Melrose is convinced that he is cursed, and Eros, the god of love, is to blame.

If only he could kill him and put an end to the never-ending cycle- surely a pipe dream for a human.

Until one day, he is passed a family heirloom, one that gives him the ability to see higher beings, along with another valuable purpose. The reality of a new world opens up before him, and suddenly, the bizarre idea might actually sound plausible.

Observe the story that unfolds and discover a shocking truth!

Will he succeed in killing Eros and finding true love?

Or does fate have other plans?
summary: To Kill Eros is a drama-filled BL Visual Novel exploring the flavors of love and the depth between people who join hands — while also blaming Eros for everything, of course!
